selection_rule.fixed_before_play: Plinko: 4 rounds on each of the 27 settings (Low rows 8 to 16, then Medium, then High) plus 26 more on Low / 8 rows and 26 more on Medium / 8 rows = 160. Keno: 3 rounds on each of the 40 settings (Classic, Low, Medium, High; 1 to 10 picks, numbers 1 to n) plus 20 more on Classic / 1 pick and 20 more on Low / 1 pick = 160. Stake 0.1 USDT on every round.
selection_rule.added_after: Plinko: 20 rounds (10 Low / 8, 10 Medium / 8) on a second seed pair whose hash was recorded first, and 2 rounds with the Bet button. Keno: 20 rounds (10 Classic / 1, 10 Low / 1) on a seed pair whose hash was recorded first, and 2 rounds with the Bet button. Added to strengthen pre-bet commitment evidence and to record Bet-button rounds, not chosen by outcome.
selection_rule.exclusions: none: every recorded round is in normalized/rounds.ndjson
selection_rule.bet_placement: 360 rounds sent by a script in the game tab that sends the game's own bet message; 4 rounds placed with the Bet button, bet message identical

consent_and_provenance: All rounds were placed with real money on one FortuneJack account made available for these tests. Captures were made in that account's own logged-in browser session. No casino or supplier was contacted.

known_gaps: Keno main run (160 rounds): the server-seed hash was obtained only after the rounds; no pre-bet record. All other 204 rounds had their hash recorded first.
No inbound configuration message was preserved; the tables are transcriptions of the live game state (Plinko) and display (Keno).
The 4 Bet-button rounds, the Plinko second-pair reveal and the three Keno reveal replies exist only as transcriptions from the game tab.
The wallet list gives per-session totals, not per-round transaction ids or balances.
10 test rounds (5 Plinko, 5 Keno) placed before recording started: wallet totals only, cannot be replayed.

The game clients contain no verifier implementation; each links a public verifier on CodePen (analysis/claims.json). Both verifiers are saved in raw/verifier/ as served on 2026-11-27; their created and updated dates are CodePen's own records. The construction is also established by replaying every recorded round. The verifiers round with parseInt() where the replay uses Math.floor(); the two differ only for a scaled value below 0.000001, and both verifiers give the replayed outcome for every recorded round (analysis/claims.json). Whether the live server shares that defect is not established.
One account, one evening, one currency; tables not established before or after the recorded period.
Minimum and maximum stake, payout cap, promotion and reward status: unknown.
Keno round 1795559705745017: credited 0.00000001 less than stake x multiplier; cause not established.
SHA-256 fingerprints detect later changes to files; they do not prove when or where a capture was made.
Earlier FortuneJack and Orbital pages are linked in archives/ as web.archive.org copies; they are not stored in this package.
